findings.title: Canonical Task origin/candidate live in NoProgressRecord, not Task
findings.evidence: createTask computes inputHash=Hash(input_refs), legacyKey=Hash([origin_problem_id,candidate_id,inputHash]); stores origin/candidate/input_hash/key_hash in NoProgressRecord; explicitly removes origin/candidate from Task and stores only Task.no_progress_record_id. Public Task is closed, requires that reference and forbids the two extra fields. Frozen binding store directly reads the forbidden Task fields, while its test hand-injects them and creates no canonical NoProgressRecord.
findings.effect: The old positive fixture is not a public-schema-valid Task. Normal canonical Tasks cannot pass this foundation relationship check; conversely fake extra Task fields substitute for the unverified canonical NoProgressRecord.
findings.required_change: Within the four-file scope, follow Task.no_progress_record_id inside the same Tx to the same-project NoProgressRecord; validate public Goal/Task/NPR shapes and exact row/body identity, Goal problem/task roster, origin/candidate, input_hash, recomputed unchanged legacy key, binding.NoProgressRef and NoProgressInputKey. Do not add Task fields, change public schema/API/legacy NoProgress policy or introduce a migration. Complete public-schema-valid three-object fixtures are sufficient; a full API/createTask invocation is not required.

findings.title: Required checker command identity is confused with display check_id
findings.evidence: mandatory values are executable command keys such as mu.turn-output-v1 and coding.pure-scalar-delivery-v1, but required membership is stored by check_id without checking command_key. A schema-valid self-digested contract can retain the same check_id while changing command_key to an unrelated handler. Existing valid client turn contracts use check_id=mu-turn-output and command_key=mu.turn-output-v1.
findings.effect: The foundation can accept absence/substitution of its mandatory execution checker and reject legitimate distinct labels. The old fixtures set id and key equal, masking the distinction.
findings.required_change: Bind mandatory presence to the explicitly intended required DETERMINISTIC command_key (or an explicitly specified id/key policy), reject duplicate/ambiguous occurrences including optional duplicates, retain unique display check_id checks and full public AcceptanceContract schema/digest validation. This does not register or execute a checker.

coverage: Three complete schema-valid Goal/Task/NPR positive objects with typed VersionRefs; Task has no origin/candidate extras.
Canonical NPR relation, fake Task extras, Goal rosters and self-consistent forged legacy key negatives.
Wrong command under the old matching label, legal independent labels under right command, optional/required duplicate command identity.
Actual existing domain.Hash, causal anchor dimensions, exact closed DTO escaped duplicate/case alias, context cancellation and rolled-back Tx.
Existing nonzero NoProgress failure/progress counters remain unchanged by binding insert/read.
